display_long_description:
Speedway Race Clash delivers fast, precise, and immersive VR racing built for the Meta Quest platform. This demo lets you test the core handling, cockpit view, and high‑speed racing across a selection of tracks.

Upgrade Call‑to‑Action
Enjoying the demo?
Get the full version for more cars, more tracks, and expanded gameplay!!!

The full version expands the experience with more cars, more tracks, improved AI, and ongoing updates.
Upgrade to the full game on the Meta Quest Store → https://www.meta.com/experiences/speedway-race-clash-ultimate-showdown/31709214785360154

Key Features
- Fast and immersive VR racing
- Smooth cockpit‑view driving
- Responsive controls
- Challenging track layout
- Optimized for Meta Quest
- Developed by Somosuno Games

Version Notes (What’s Included in the Demo)
- Core racing experience
- Cockpit driving
- 3 Tracks selection
- Base vehicle handling
- Preview of the full game’s gameplay style
